breaking.change: The engine resolves as a package: og keeps `node_modules/@origingame/engine` (ignored by Git) pointing at the engine it runs with, in place of `.og/engine`, and TypeScript, the bundler and an editor read `@origingame/engine` and every subpath from the engine's package.json `exports` (`moduleResolution "bundler"`). A tsconfig.json `paths` entry into `.og/engine` names a link that no longer exists. `bun:test`'s declarations are the export `@origingame/engine/bun-test`, named in `types`. A bare entry outside a project (no project.ogt) is no longer type-checked: it has no link.
breaking.fix: `og upgrade` drops the `@origingame/engine…` and `bun:test` entries into `.og/engine` from tsconfig.json's `paths` (and the block when nothing else is left in it) and adds `"@origingame/engine/bun-test"` to `types`; it lists a line it cannot take (two entries on one line) for you to edit the same way. Check a bare entry inside a project, or run it with --no-check.

added.summary: The vendored `bun:test` declarations as an export of the engine package: `"types": ["@origingame/engine/bun-test"]` in tsconfig.json types a playtest file's describe, test and expect.
